brief: A 6-step digital marketing plan that transforms clicks into customers.

slots.title: Know Your Audience
slots.body: Figure out who actually wants your stuff. Dig into demographics, pain points, and where they hang out online. The better you know them, the cheaper your ads become.

slots.title: Craft Bold Offers
slots.body: Stop selling features and start selling outcomes. Package your product as the no-brainer solution to their biggest headache. Make saying yes feel easy.

slots.title: Optimize Landing Pages
slots.body: Your page has one job: convert. Strip away distractions, speed up load times, and write copy that feels like a conversation. One clear CTA wins every time.

slots.title: Nurture With Email
slots.body: Not everyone buys on day one. Set up a welcome sequence that builds trust and delivers value. Show up in their inbox like a helpful friend.

slots.title: Retarget Lost Clicks
slots.body: Most visitors won't convert immediately. Run reminder ads that speak to exactly what they viewed. A gentle nudge often closes the deal.

slots.title: Analyze And Scale
slots.body: Watch your data like a hawk. Double down on what works and kill what doesn't. Scaling smart beats spending big every single time.
